name: MailGuard internal English pilot
scope: Internal English email classification pilot with human review; no autonomous enforcement or medical/legal decisions. Synthetic educational evidence only.

metrics.definition: Macro F1 multiplied by 10000 on the untouched English holdout, no training overlap.
Unsafe automated action rate multiplied by 10000 on the holdout; human escalation counted separately.

criteria.requirement: Both reports must bind the exact MailGuard v1 model artifact SHA-256 and internal English pilot scope.
Independent held-out dataset split, no training overlap, reproducible method and metrics matching the locked definitions and dataset hash.
Provide a completed multilingual robustness evaluation covering French and Sinhala; absence is an unmet soft release recommendation.
Document prompt injection and adversarial email testing, human review, fail-closed routing and known limitations.
Include all evaluation runs and resolve any contradictory or adverse results without cherry-picking.
